assertion_results.text: Tasks target both 'trustify-backend' and 'trustify-ui' repositories with at least one task per repo
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md Task list: Tasks 1, 2, 8 have '## Repository trustify-backend'; Tasks 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9 have '## Repository trustify-ui' (confirmed in each task-N-*.md file).

assertion_results.text: Backend tasks have lower task numbers than the frontend tasks that depend on them
assertion_results.evidence: The only frontend-to-backend dependency is task-3-frontend-compare-api-client.md 'Depends on: Task 2 — Add GET /api/v2/sbom/compare endpoint' (2 < 3). Tasks 4-7 and 9 depend only on frontend tasks (3, 4, 5, 6, 7). No frontend task depends on backend Task 8.

assertion_results.text: UI-facing frontend tasks (pages, components) reference Figma design context mentioning specific PatternFly components and visual specifications — API-layer frontend tasks (API types, client functions, hooks) are exempt from this requirement
assertion_results.evidence: Tasks 4, 5, 7 do reference Figma (Task 4 '**Figma header toolbar:**' PF Select/Button/EmptyState/CodeBranchIcon; Task 5 'Sections, columns and badge colors (Figma, in this order)' with PF tokens like --pf-v5-global--success-color--100; Task 7 'Figma: "Export" is a secondary Dropdown'). However, the UI-facing Task 6 (task-6-frontend-sbom-list-compare-selected.md, which modifies src/pages/SbomListPage/SbomListPage.tsx to add selection checkboxes and a 'Compare selected' button) contains no reference to Figma design context at all. It names PF components ('composable Table row selection', 'Button (variant secondary)'), but these aren't tied to any Figma design. Because one UI-facing task doesn't meet the requirement, this fails.

assertion_results.text: Cross-repo dependency ordering is enforced: either at least one frontend task explicitly depends on a backend task in its Dependencies section, or all tasks target a shared feature branch where backend tasks have lower task numbers than frontend tasks (implicit ordering via feature-branch workflow)
assertion_results.evidence: task-3-frontend-compare-api-client.md '## Dependencies - Depends on: Task 2 — Add GET /api/v2/sbom/compare endpoint (contract source of truth)'; task-creation-log.md Depend links 'TC-T3 | TC-T2'.

assertion_results.evidence: All 9 task files have '## Target Branch' set to 'main'; impact-map.md Step 4.5 says 'Selected mode: direct-to-main ... All tasks target main; no bookend tasks generated'.

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:'
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-digest.md through task-9-digest.md (9 files, one per task) each contain '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<hex>', e.g. task-1 'sha256-md:c3feff2eff1c87a1bbb9a018511655bcf3f0b16fb6a80609e1b915d423b1b905'. All 9 hashes are 64 lowercase hex characters (verified by regex [0-9a-f]+ and length count).

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: All 20 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §' lines across Tasks 1-7 have a matching 'Applies:' line (counts match per file: 2/3/3/4/4/2/2), each naming a specific file from Files to Modify/Create, e.g. Task 2 'Applies: task modifies `modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/mod.rs` matching the convention's `endpoints/mod.rs` route-registration scope.' and Task 3 'Applies: task creates `src/hooks/useSbomComparison.ts` matching the convention's `src/hooks/*.ts` scope.' No task file contains 'Not applicable' or 'N/A'. Backend conventions don't appear in frontend tasks, and frontend conventions don't appear in backend tasks.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md Step 1 'Priority | Critical (set → propagate)'; Step 6 additional_fields '"priority": {"name": "Critical"}'; task-creation-log.md 'priority | Critical | Propagated (set, not "Undefined")'; each task file has '**Priority:** Critical (inherited from TC-9003)'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md 'Fix Versions | RHTPA 1.5.0 (set → propagate; `fixVersion scope: both`)' and additional_fields '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'; task-creation-log.md 'fixVersions | RHTPA 1.5.0 | Propagated (non-empty; `fixVersion scope: both`)'; every task file has '**Fix Versions:** RHTPA 1.5.0 (inherited from TC-9003)'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
